answer_1.quote: We propose a state-of-the-art translation model that generates Hindi-English CS text starting from monolingual Hindi text.

answer_2.quote: We present four different objective evaluation metrics to evaluate synthetic CS text: BERTScore, Accuracy of a BERT-based classifier and two diversity scores

answer_4.quote: We evaluated the quality of sentences generated by TCS using a human evaluation study. We sampled 150 sentences ... given to three linguistic experts in Hindi and they were asked to provide scores ranging between 1 and 5 ... under three heads: 'Syntactic correctness', 'Semantic correctness' and 'Naturalness'.
answer_4.guideline: Experts provided scores (1-5) for syntactic correctness, semantic correctness, and naturalness.
